metadata.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
metadata.source: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.409–436

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Radar에서 표적까지의 range를 결정하는 기본 원리는?

choices.text: 전파가 표적까지 갔다가 돌아오는 시간을 측정한다

questions.explanation: 원문은 전파가 물체까지 갔다가 되돌아오는 시간을 빛의 속도와 함께 이용해 range를 결정한다고 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.409

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Radar site에서 탐지된 물체의 direction은 무엇으로 결정하는가?

choices.text: 반사파 수신 시 rotating antenna의 위치

questions.explanation: 반사된 radio wave가 수신될 때 rotating antenna의 position으로 direction을 결정한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.409

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Radar service limitation에 관한 설명으로 맞는 것은?

choices.text: 모든 비관제 항공기에도 항상 traffic advisory 제공 가능
Radar에 보이지 않는 항공기에는 advisory가 제한될 수 있다
Primary radar는 지형의 영향을 받지 않는다

questions.explanation: ATC가 통제하지 않고 radar에도 보이지 않는 항공기에 대해 traffic advisory를 항상 제공할 수 있는 것은 아니다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.409

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Anomalous propagation 또는 ducting은 무엇을 의미하는가?

choices.text: Radar pulse가 대기 현상으로 굽는 현상

questions.explanation: Temperature inversion 등으로 radar pulse가 굽는 현상을 anomalous propagation/ducting이라 한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.410

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Radar beam이 지상 쪽으로 비정상적으로 굽으면 나타날 수 있는 현상은?

choices.text: 많은 extraneous blips가 나타날 수 있다

questions.explanation: Beam이 지상 쪽으로 bent되면 operator display에 extraneous blips가 많이 나타날 수 있다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.410

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: MTI의 부정적 특성으로 원문이 설명한 것은?

choices.text: Blind/tangential speed의 aircraft가 표시되지 않을 수 있다

questions.explanation: Aircraft speed가 MTI canceling signal과 일치하는 tangential/blind speed이면 display되지 않을 수 있다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.410

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: 낮은 고도의 항공기가 primary radar에 보이지 않을 수 있는 이유로 원문에 포함된 것은?
questions.explanation: Mountain에 가려지거나 earth curvature 때문에 radar beam 아래에 위치할 수 있다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.410

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Secondary-radar-only 또는 ADS-B 지역에서 transponder와 ADS-B가 모두 없는 항공기는?

choices.text: Radar service를 정상 제공받을 수 있다

questions.explanation: Secondary-only/ADS-B coverage에서는 해당 equipment가 없는 aircraft에 radar service를 제공할 수 없다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.410

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: 원문의 rule of thumb에서 wind turbine farm으로 간주되는 turbine 수는?
questions.explanation: 원문 NOTE는 일반적으로 3개 이상의 turbine을 wind turbine farm으로 본다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.411

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: 극단적인 wind turbine detection loss는 nearest turbine 주변 수평으로 어느 거리보다 더 뻗을 수 있는가?
questions.explanation: 원문은 extreme circumstances에서 1.0 NM보다 더 수평으로 확장될 수 있다고 한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.411

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Non-Transponder/Non-ADS-B Out aircraft가 wind turbine farm 주변에서 피하도록 권고되는 범위는?
questions.explanation: 원문은 interference 회피를 위해 수평 1.0 NM 이내를 모든 고도에서 피하도록 권고한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.411

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: FIG 4-5-2의 NOTE가 인용하는 구조물 등에 대한 최소 접근 거리 기준은?
questions.explanation: 14 CFR §91.119(c)의 500 ft 기준이 인용되어 있다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.411

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Wind turbine farm 인근 Non-Transponder/Non-ADS-B Out aircraft에 대해 ATC가 할 수 없는 것으로 강조된 것은?
questions.explanation: 이들 항공기는 radar/TIS-B에 나타나지 않을 수 있어 ATC가 separation을 제공할 수 없다고 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.412

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Controller의 첫 우선순위는?

choices.text: ATC 통제 하 IFR aircraft 사이 separation 설정

questions.explanation: Vertical/lateral/longitudinal separation between IFR aircraft under ATC control이 first priority다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.412

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: FAA radar unit의 서비스에 관한 원문 설명으로 맞는 것은?

choices.text: Civil과 military pilots 모두 이용 가능

questions.explanation: Chart Supplement에 표시된 FAA radar unit은 지속 운용되며 civil/military 모두 이용 가능하다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.412

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Wind turbine가 일반적으로 크게 영향을 주지 않는 surveillance return은?
questions.explanation: 원문은 transponder/ADS-B Out equipped aircraft에 대한 surveillance radar return quality는 일반적으로 영향이 크지 않다고 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.410

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: ATCRBS의 세 주요 구성요소가 아닌 것은?
questions.explanation: ATCRBS의 세 요소는 Interrogator, Transponder, Radarscope다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.412

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: ATCRBS Interrogator의 역할은?

choices.text: Ground에서 transponder에 interrogation을 보내 reply를 요청한다

questions.explanation: Interrogator는 ground-based radar beacon transmitter-receiver로 transponder reply를 반복 요청한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.412

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: ATCRBS transponder reply는 primary radar return과 비교해?
questions.explanation: 원문은 transponder replies가 primary radar return과 독립적이고 훨씬 강하다고 한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.412

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: ATCRBS decoder가 수신하도록 설계된 altitude information은?
questions.explanation: Decoder equipment는 Mode C altitude information도 수신한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.413

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: ASR의 주된 용도는?
questions.explanation: ASR은 airport vicinity의 상대적 short-range coverage와 terminal traffic 처리를 위한 surveillance radar다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.413

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: ARSR의 주된 특징은?
questions.explanation: ARSR은 넓은 지역의 aircraft location display를 위한 long-range system이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.413

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: PAR coverage의 range 제한은?
questions.explanation: PAR range는 10 miles로 제한된다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.413

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: PAR scope의 upper half가 제공하는 정보는?
questions.explanation: Upper half는 altitude and distance, lower half는 azimuth and distance를 표시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.413

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: ASDE-X/ASSC primary radar coverage의 상단은 airport surface 위 약?
questions.explanation: 원문은 airport surface와 surface 위 200 ft까지라고 한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.414

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: ASDE-X/ASSC primary radar가 탐지할 수 있는 대상으로 맞는 것은?
questions.explanation: Transponder가 없거나 malfunctioning한 aircraft도 primary radar로 detect/display할 수 있다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.414

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: ASDE-X/ASSC의 MSDP 역할은?

choices.text: 여러 sensor report를 single target으로 결합

questions.explanation: Multi-sensor Data Processor가 모든 sensor report를 single target으로 결합한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.414

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Tower에서 airport operation의 seamless picture를 제공하는 것은?
questions.explanation: Control tower cab의 high-resolution color monitor가 surface picture를 제공한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.414

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Table 4-5-1에서 ASDE-X operational facility로 기재된 공항은?
questions.explanation: BWI는 Table 4-5-1 ASDE-X 목록에 있으며 SFO/CLE/ADW는 Table 4-5-2 ASSC projected 목록에 있다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.414

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Table 4-5-1에서 LAX는?
questions.explanation: LAX는 Los Angeles International이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.415

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Table 4-5-2에서 SFO는?
questions.explanation: SFO는 projected ASSC facility Table 4-5-2에 있다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.415

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Table 4-5-2의 ADW는 어떤 시설인가?
questions.explanation: ADW는 Joint Base Andrews AFB로 기재된다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.416

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS가 한 client에 제공하는 intruder 최대 수는?
questions.explanation: TIS는 최대 8 intruder aircraft를 제공한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.416

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS proximity volume의 horizontal 범위는?
questions.explanation: Client 기준 horizontal 7 NM이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.416

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS proximity volume의 vertical 범위는?
questions.explanation: 원문은 +3,500 ft와 -3,000 ft를 제시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.416

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: 7 NM보다 먼 TIS target range의 의미는?

choices.text: 34초 안에 threat가 될 수 있음을 의미

questions.explanation: 7 NM보다 먼 target은 precise distance가 아니라 34초 내 threat 가능을 뜻한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.416

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS surveillance data uplink 주기는 nominally?
questions.explanation: 각 radar scan마다 uplink되며 nominally 5 seconds다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.416

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS capable terminal Mode S site에서 보통 service를 기대할 수 있는 거리로 제시된 것은?
questions.explanation: Typically within 55 NM of FIG 4-5-4 sites라고 설명한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.416

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS를 수신하기 위해 ATC communication은?
questions.explanation: TIS 수신 자체에 ATC communication은 requirement가 아니지만 airspace/operation에 따라 통신은 별도로 필요할 수 있다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.416

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: FIG 4-5-4의 제목은?
questions.explanation: FIG 4-5-4는 Terminal Mode S Radar Sites이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.417

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS client 기본 장비 기능에 포함되는 것은?

choices.text: Mode S data link transponder with altitude encoder

questions.explanation: FIG 4-5-5 관련 requirements에 Mode S data link transponder with altitude encoder가 포함된다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.418

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS client의 optional equipment로 제시된 것은?
questions.explanation: Crab angle/turning maneuver display error correction을 위한 digital heading source가 optional이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.419

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Intruder가 TIS client에 보이기 위한 최소 조건은?
questions.explanation: Intruder는 최소 operating transponder(Mode A, C or S)를 가져야 한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.419

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Intruder가 8개보다 많으면 TIS는?
questions.explanation: Closest proximity/greatest threat 등 가장 significant한 8개가 uplink된다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.419

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS relative bearing 정보의 increment는?
questions.explanation: Relative bearing은 6-degree increments다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.419

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS estimated intruder ground track increment는?
questions.explanation: Ground track은 45-degree increments로 제공된다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.419

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Intruder가 client에서 1,000 ft 이내일 때 relative altitude increment는?
questions.explanation: Within 1,000 feet는 100-foot increments이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.419

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS altitude trend에서 level로 보는 기준은?
questions.explanation: Level within 500 fpm, climbing/descending >500 fpm으로 표시한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.420

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS Alert가 식별하는 것은?
questions.explanation: Alert는 34초 이내 potential collision hazard를 식별한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.420

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS threat criterion의 예상 closest approach lateral 기준은?
questions.explanation: 30초 미만의 closest approach time과 함께 lateral 0.5 NM, vertical 500 ft 이내가 기준이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.420

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS Coasting은 display가 몇 초보다 오래되었을 때?
questions.explanation: Display가 6 seconds보다 old이면 Coasting이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.420

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS information이 12초보다 오래되면 표시되는 status는?
questions.explanation: 12초보다 오래되면 No Traffic status가 indicated된다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.420

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS uplink가 60초 이상 missing일 때?
questions.explanation: TIS Unavailable은 no ground system 또는 uplink missing 60 seconds 이상일 때 표시된다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.420

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS Good-bye의 의미는?
questions.explanation: Client aircraft가 TIS coverage 밖으로 나갔음을 뜻한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.420

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: FIG 4-5-5 example display의 orientation은?
questions.explanation: 원문 example은 track up이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.420

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: FIG 4-5-5 data block의 “-07”은?
questions.explanation: -07은 intruder가 client보다 700 ft 낮음을 뜻한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.421

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS의 용도에 관한 맞는 설명은?
questions.explanation: TIS는 visual acquisition 보조용이며 collision avoidance system이 아니다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.421

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS client altitude encoder가 disabled이면?
questions.explanation: Client altitude reporting이 required이므로 encoder disabled/inoperative 시 TIS unavailable이다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.421

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Altitude reporting이 없는 intruder는 alert 계산에서 어떻게 가정되는가?
questions.explanation: Alert computation에서는 client와 같은 altitude로 가정한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.422

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS coverage의 기본 성격은?

choices.text: Ground secondary radar의 line-of-sight limitation 적용

questions.explanation: TIS는 ground-based secondary surveillance radar 기반으로 line-of-sight/terrain/earth curvature 제한을 받는다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.422

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS zenith cone setting은 radar horizon 기준?
questions.explanation: 원문은 34 degrees라고 한다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.422

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: Zenith cone 때문에 coverage가 사라지고 adjacent radar도 없으면?
questions.explanation: 다른 TIS-capable radar가 없으면 Good-bye message 후 service가 종료된다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.422

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS intermittent operation 가능성을 높이는 장비 조건은?
questions.explanation: Turn/maneuver 시 antenna diversity가 없으면 aircraft structure가 ground radar line-of-sight를 가릴 수 있다.
questions.reference: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5 · p.422

questions.subject: Jeppesen Airway Manual · Radio Data - General · Section 5. Surveillance Systems
questions.question: TIS limitation에서 avoidance maneuver는?
